v1.0.0.name: whiskeyfur/apache-engine
v1.0.0.description: Reads an Apache configuration and works out where a URL ends up: which virtual host takes it, what the rewrite rules do to it, and which directives applied, step by step. For a server it is running on, or for a snapshot of one it is not.
